description: This file defines the SkillAPI class, which provides CRUD API endpoints for managing skills within an HR management system, including methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting skills, with associated validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: SkillAPI
classes.description: API class providing CRUD operations for Skill entities, including retrieval, creation, update, and delete functionalities, with validation and Swagger annotations.

methods.name: getSkillService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the SkillService instance used for skill data operations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single Skill by ID and returns it as a SkillModel wrapped in an EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all skills filtered and paginated according to request parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Skill entity based on request data and returns it as a SkillModel.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Skill identified by ID with new data and returns the updated SkillModel.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes Skills based on an array of IDs provided in the request.

methods.name: saveSkill
methods.description: Populates a Skill entity with data from the request and persists it via the SkillService.
